supporting_observations.claim: From 13:33 through 13:48 UTC, FILE-HD-01 logged repeated network logon failures for svc-claimsync at roughly one-minute intervals. The events report the FILE-HD-01 workstation name and wrong-password status; corresponding domain-controller validation records also report incorrect credentials.

The repeated failures are consistent with the supplied context that svc-claimsync was scheduled for password rotation at 13:30 UTC and its job re-authenticates every minute; the records alone do not establish that this is the cause.
At 14:07 UTC, WS-OHADDAD-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event using svc-claimsync for PROXY-HD-01, with the process identified as Commvault GxCVD.exe running as SYSTEM.

That credential use is anomalous in the supplied environment context: the listed backup agent is CobaltVault on FILE-HD-01, and Commvault on WS-OHADDAD-01 using svc-claimsync to reach the proxy is not described as an approved practice. This raises concern but does not by itself prove malicious activity or a successful logon.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, including the time of the 14:07 explicit-credentials event; the stated reason is a collection outage.
Although sysmon and Zeek sensor status is reported as OK, no corresponding sysmon, connection, DNS, or SSL event records were supplied for review.
claims_not_established: Whether the explicit-credentials attempt to PROXY-HD-01 succeeded or generated proxy requests.
Whether Commvault GxCVD.exe was legitimately installed or launched on WS-OHADDAD-01, and who or what initiated it.
Whether any data was transferred or any unapproved service was accessed through the proxy.
Whether the failed svc-claimsync logons resulted from the scheduled rotation and stale job credentials, or whether the job was subsequently updated.
Whether svc-claimsync credentials were compromised or used elsewhere.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC and determine whether the 14:07 event was followed by a successful authentication, requests, or transfers.
Collect WS-OHADDAD-01 process creation, file and installation history, and relevant endpoint telemetry for GxCVD.exe around 14:07 UTC; verify its signer, hash, and business owner.
Review FILE-HD-01 ClaimSync job and service configuration, rotation/change records, and authentication results after 13:48 UTC to confirm whether the job retained an old password or was updated.
Review available Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL records and sysmon telemetry for the relevant hosts and time window.
